notes: YOUR LICENCE NOW TAKES EFFECT THE MOMENT YOU ENTER IT. Before this release, the parts of the ledger you had just paid for stayed locked until the app was restarted — which looked for all the world as though the key had not worked. Enter your key and the modules open there and then. A LICENSED COPY NO LONGER CALLS ITSELF A TRIAL. The window title drops the word the instant your key is accepted. An unlicensed evaluation copy still says so plainly, because a trial and a paid copy can sit on the same computer with separate books and must never be confused for one another. THE LICENCE SCREEN CAN BE FOUND BY SEARCH — press Command-K, or Control-K on Windows, and type licence; previously it could only be reached from the foot of the menu. And a menu section with nothing left under it no longer shows an empty heading. A NEW INSTALLATION NOW STARTS FROM THE GENERAL GHANAIAN BUSINESS CHART — 186 accounts, with PAYE, SSNIT tiers 1 to 3, output and input VAT, withholding tax, the tourism levy and mobile money already in place. A university IPSAS chart of 841 accounts is still offered in the setup wizard for institutions that need it. EXISTING INSTALLATIONS KEEP THE CHART THEY ALREADY USE — nothing moves and nothing is renamed. THE APP CAN NO LONGER OPEN TO A BLANK SCREEN. macOS sometimes asks for your keychain password when an app starts, most often just after installing a new version because each build is signed afresh. That question could previously arrive before the window had been drawn, leaving the app sitting with your books open and nothing on screen. The window now comes first, so anything the system asks arrives over a window you can see. NO DATABASE CHANGE: your data and settings are untouched and you install straight over the old version. Please still take a backup first — Backup & Export, Back up now.
